nativeImplementation.units: Flutter logical pixels; HTML/CSS component snippets are documentation translations, not production widgets.
nativeImplementation.evidence: Seven .impeccable/review PNGs are synthetic Flutter widget-test fixtures, not live installed-network captures.
nativeImplementation.ramps: No normative tonal ramps are defined by these source tokens; metadata does not invent a second palette.

components.name: Route selection
components.description: Two native choices with selected semantics and equal widths; routing explanation remains outside.
components.css: .ds-route{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:4px;background:#101B2B;border:1px solid #DDE2E81F;border-radius:13px}.ds-route button{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:12px 10px;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:transparent;color:#DDE2E8;font:500 14px Jost,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-route button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#F6F7F9;color:#070B16}.ds-route button:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #AEB6C2}.ds-route button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #5EEAD4;outline-offset:1px}.ds-route button:active{opacity:.8}

components.description: Compact channel destination row, replacing decorative stacked cards.

components.name: Settings group
components.description: Tonal settings grouping; native ListTile and Switch remain the actual widgets.

components.name: Native text field

components.name: Session ledger

narrative.overview: Night-water grounds, pearl text and Jost preserve Sonar's identity. Explicit native controls let connection state and the next action lead. The signature drop carries living connection color; controls use solid tonal surfaces and fine boundaries. Settings group native rows, while measurements form an open ledger.
keyCharacteristics: Responsive connection stage and route rail

rules.name: State is also text
rules.body: Connection state has an explicit title and action rather than relying only on drop color.

rules.name: Tonal controls
rules.body: Use solid surfaces and thin boundaries; the legacy sonarGlass helper does not imply blur.

rules.name: Scale and scroll
rules.body: Respect text scaling and keep essential controls reachable through vertical scrolling.

dos: Keep the dark identity, Jost and pearl drop.
Preserve native keyboard and state semantics.
donts: Defeat reduced motion or use color as the only state signal.
